title: Laalo: Krishna Sada Sahaayate
desc: Haunted by his past and desperate for change, Laalo enters a farmhouse where divine visions of Krishna lead him on a journey of self-discovery and inner transformation.

title: Main Hoon Lucky the Racer
desc: Two brothers, who are polar opposites, have always been at odds with each other since childhood. However, their enmity with a wicked politician unites them.

title: Baby & Baby
desc: Things take an unexpected turn when two couples, heading to their families' homes to introduce their babies, accidentally switch their infants.

title: Saiyaara
desc: Passionate lovers navigate a rollercoaster romance, facing euphoric highs and crushing lows while desperately clinging to their tumultuous bond.

title: Taare Zameen Par
desc: Ishaan is criticised by his parents for his poor academic performance and is sent away to a boarding school. Ram, an art teacher, however, realises he has dyslexia and helps him uncover his potential.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
desc: Raised by a tribe, a young man sets out to help his lady love rescue an enslaved princess of a kingdom that is ruled by a tyrannical king. In doing so, he soon discovers his true identity.

title: The Final Destination
desc: A youngster predicts the death of his friends in a car crash and convinces them to avoid the event. However, people around him begin to die under mysterious and horrifying circumstances.
